captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable, rectangular luggage tag plate with rounded corners. It has a flat, thin profile suitable for 3D printing. One end of the plate features a narrow, rounded vertical slit meant for attaching a strap or string, while the main body of the plate is designed to accommodate multiple lines of custom text.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric luggage tag in OpenSCAD with customizable dimensions, corner rounding, and a strap slit. The script must support dynamic text rendering (up to 10 lines) with adjustable font, size, spacing, and styling options such as engraving, embossing, or hiding the text inside.
captions.factory: The code generates a primary rectangular plate using 'cube' based on calculated text dimensions and margins. Rounded corners are created by using 'difference' to subtract corner blocks, which are defined by subtracting a 'cylinder' from a small 'cube'. A strap slit is cut out by combining a central 'cube' and two 'cylinder' primitives at the ends. Custom text is rendered using the 'write' module, placed conditionally inside a 'difference' block for engraving (text_style <= 0) or added as a separate union for embossing (text_style > 0).
